typography.heading_strategy: Playfair Display, fluid scales (text-4xl to text-6xl), tracking-tight, leading-none. Used for H1, H2, H3.
typography.body_strategy: Manrope, text-base to text-lg, leading-relaxed, tracking-normal. Used for paragraphs, small labels, UI elements.
typography.uppercase_labels: tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-xs or text-sm for overlines and tags

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, p-16, py-24 for section paddings.
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Asymmetric grids for marketing sections. Bento-box style for HR & Compliance cards. Massive full-width-spanning premium cards for the TWO CORE PILLARS.
spacing_and_layout.corners: Rounded-xl or rounded-2xl for soft premium feel, or sharp edges if aiming for stricter corporate. Let's use rounded-2xl (16px) for massive pillar cards and rounded-lg for smaller cards to soften the dark enterprise theme.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.glassmorphism: Used for sticky header and overlaid feature cards. backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0E17]/70 border-b border-white/5
surfaces_and_micro_themes.premium_cards: Flat surface (#131A26) with subtle 1px border (#242E3D). On hover, border transitions to gold (#D4AF37) and slight shadow-lg glow.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.pillar_cards: Massive container (bg-[#0A0E17]), inner content wrapped in glassmorphic or rich dark navy panels. Active tabs highlight in gold.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-[#D4AF37] text-[#0A0E17] hover:bg-[#F0C850] transition-colors. Secondary buttons: border border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/10.

motion_and_interaction.scroll_reveal: Sections fade in and translate up (y: 30 -> 0) while scrolling into view.
motion_and_interaction.hover_effects: Cards slightly lift (-translate-y-1) with border color transition to gold.
motion_and_interaction.expandable_panels: Accordion/tabs in the Two Pillars must use AnimatePresence for smooth height/opacity transitions.

icons.style: Stroke-based, consistent width. Use gold color for primary icons, text_muted for secondary.

components.header: Sticky nav, backdrop blur, logo wordmark (Playfair Display), anchor links with smooth scroll.
components.hero: Dark navy bg, subtle gold abstract background image (opacity 15%), large typography, dual CTAs.
components.about: Grid layout. Image on left, typography on right. Company story, 2018 origin.
components.why_us: Bento grid of benefits with animated icons.
components.core_pillars: Section titled 'Our Core Pillars'. Two massive interactive containers. Tabbed or accordion interface inside each to switch between services (Temporary Staffing, Soft Services, etc.).
components.hr_compliance: Grid of 13 premium cards (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4). Each has a subtle icon, title, and hover effect.
components.process_timeline: Horizontal scrolling or vertical zig-zag timeline with 14 steps. Use gold dots and connecting lines.
components.locations: 3 map-styled cards for Mumbai, Kolkata, Bhiwandi.
components.footer: Deep navy, massive 'VEGITH PINNACLE' wordmark (text-[8vw]), links, contact info, copyright.

hero_background.description: Abstract dark gold sphere, used as a subtle background element in hero with low opacity.

staffing_pillar.description: Professional corporate team collaborating, used for the Staffing Services pillar card.

facility_management_pillar.description: Industrial maintenance worker, used for the Facility Management Services pillar card.

about_image.description: Modern commercial building facade, used in the About section to establish premium corporate presence.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, tabs, accordion triggers, form inputs) must have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS for styling and Framer Motion for animations.
Implement a smooth scroll behavior for the anchor links in the sticky header.

The 'Core Pillars' section MUST dominate the layout. Do not use small standard cards for them. Use expansive, screen-wide or container-wide UI elements where the user clicks tabs to reveal the internal list of services. Add high-end imagery.
Use the exact color hex codes provided to maintain the Deep Navy + Gold Luxury theme.
Ensure headings use Playfair Display and body uses Manrope. Add font imports via Google Fonts in index.css.
For the 14-step Process Flow, design a clean vertical timeline or a custom grid layout to prevent vertical exhaustion.
